VOIDLINE / SOURCE ARTWORK ATTRIBUTION
Current edition4 / 19 November2026

Actual web photographs, illustrations, marks and meme images.
Conventional cropping, rasterization, recoloring and composites are described per item.
No AI image generation or generative fill is used for current collectible art.
A source URL or brand publication does not imply a reuse license. Unknown rights remain explicit.

LARP PRO MAX [larp]
Creator: XxxBaloooxxx
Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Man_in_LARP_gear.jpg
Rights: CC BY-SA 3.0; this cropped/resized derivative is offered under the same license.
License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/3.0/
Preparation: Crop from original pixels [65, 55, 515, 505]. Resized with Lanczos and cover placement on a flat #1c2b23 square; prepared as 512px artwork and a separate 64px miniature. No AI generation, vector tracing or synthetic character redraw. Final prepared raster conventionally transcoded to JPEG with a PNG optical miniature for self-contained SVG compatibility; no new drawing or AI-generated imagery.

Rights: Public domain historical drawing (Commons record); underlying author died in 1895; this sketch was published in 1898.
License: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Friedrich_Engels_-_Max_Stirner_(1892)_V02-1.2_raw.jpg#Licensing
Preparation: Crop from original pixels [160, 295, 430, 665]. Resized with Lanczos and contain placement on a flat #f4f3ee square; prepared as 512px artwork and a separate 64px miniature. Final prepared raster conventionally transcoded to JPEG with a PNG optical miniature for self-contained SVG compatibility; no new drawing or AI-generated imagery.

Blockchain [coin-blockchain]
Creator: Blockchain.com brand design team; original individual designer not identified on the published asset.
Source: https://www.blockchain.com/
Rights: Official published brand asset; no open redistribution license identified. Blockchain.com retains brand and trademark rights.
Preparation: Actual official SVG downloaded from the Blockchain.com homepage. Cropped to the existing left 24×24 block-mark area, rasterized with Inkscape, centered on a transparent 512px canvas and resized to a 64px miniature. PNG encoding only; no recoloring, AI generation, vector tracing or redrawn paths. Final prepared raster conventionally transcoded to PNG with a PNG optical miniature for self-contained SVG compatibility; no new drawing or AI-generated imagery. Final PNG palette optimized to at most256 colors without redrawing the source.
